item.ultimate_enchanting.matadioses_7.lo: A single rune glows on the blade. It is the first fragment of a name the world forgot.
item.ultimate_enchanting.matadioses_10.l: Two runes preserve an ancient oath. The second inscription seems to answer the first.
item.ultimate_enchanting.matadioses_13.l: Three runes were carved after a battle erased from history. One bears a mark as if torn from the metal.
item.ultimate_enchanting.matadioses_16.l: Four runes survived centuries of war. No wielder understood the inscription was incomplete.
item.ultimate_enchanting.matadioses_20.l: Five runes almost complete the true name. Something no blade can hold is still missing: what unites them.
